model_kind: encoder-only verifier: last-token pooled Qwen3-8B hidden state plus two MLP projection heads
limiting_reason: serving default of upstream clm-serve (2048); traced prefill buckets 128 / 256 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 (x batch 1 / 4 / 8) captured at startup; longer inputs are truncated to their last 2048 tokens
capacity_evidence: doc/full_model/fidelity_accuracy.json and doc/optimized_full_model/fidelity_accuracy_buckets5.json (2047 and 2048-token corpus texts, cosine >= 0.9996), doc/optimized_full_model/bench_accuracy_buckets5.json (2048-token rows), doc/optimized_full_model/replay_trace_check_accuracy_buckets5.json (2048 variants)
input_truncation: tail: the last max_tokens tokens are kept, matching vLLM truncate_prompt_tokens as used by clm-serve
decode_contract: not applicable (encoder-only; no autoregressive decode, no KV reuse across requests)
batch_contract: right-padded batches grouped by padded prefill bucket (smallest of 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048 that fits the longest text in the group; env CLM_TRACE_LENS overrides the list, multiples of 128 only), batch padded to 1, 4 or 8; per-user last token index
output: 4096-d L2-normalized float32 embedding per input; heads produce 512-d projections; score = 100 * cosine
bucket_evidence: doc/optimized_full_model/README.md, section 'Prefill buckets': single-text vectors are bit-identical between the 128/1024/2048 and the 128/256/512/1024/2048 bucket sets (308 of 308 corpus texts)
program_config_overrides: single-chip meshes only, env CLM_PROGRAM_CONFIGS=0 restores the stock path: QKV prefill matmul at 128 tokens uses in0_block_w 4 and out subblock 1x4 on the stock 32-core footprint; QKV and w2 prefill matmuls above 128 tokens use MinimalMatmul on an 11x10 grid (stock 8x10 and 8x8); evidence doc/optimized_decoder/program_config_experiment_<len>.json and doc/optimized_full_model/README.md
sharded_norm: single-chip meshes only, env CLM_SHARDED_NORM=0 restores the stock path: the two decoder RMSNorms run block-sharded on an 8x4 core grid when the prefill batch has 128, 256 or 512 rows in total (batch x padded length); larger shapes use the stock interleaved norm
